summary: Lookout station in Bridger-Teton NF, Lincoln County, WY, placed in service 1941; sources disagree on cabin vs tower; FFLA lists it as standing; no access information found.

facts.design: Described three ways: a cabin (firelookout.com), a 'Ground' type (FFLA list), and a 'lookout tower' (2007 item quoted by Forest Lookouts)

events.note: Forest Lookouts says the lookout station was placed in service in 1941; no construction date given
Middle Fire, reported August 16, 2007; firefighters wrapped the lookout tower as a precaution

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources describe the lookout as a cabin (firelookout.com), a 'Ground' type (FFLA list) and a lookout tower (2007 item quoted by Forest Lookouts). The story reports all three descriptions and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Sources conflict on whether the structure is a tower or a cabin. The 2007 fire item is quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; its original publisher, Teton Valley News, was not opened. The Buckrail article speaks of towers and may not cover this site. The brief's elevation (2596 m) was not checked against a source we read; 'Ground' matches the FFLA list. Do not confuse this with the Elk Mountain Fire Lookout in the Black Hills National Forest, South Dakota, which appeared in search results only and is not cited. Access and staffing are unknown.
